reason: Already open pages can still request a published image URL after the photo is moved to a different event. Keep these image URLs available.
retries: Failed thumbnail and slideshow image requests retry after 300ms and 1200ms with a fresh image URL. Successful requests are not reloaded.
localFaultTest: Four timeline thumbnails recovered after injected 503s (including two consecutive failures); slideshow advanced to photo 2 after an injected 503; popup image remained visible.
caption: På billederne ses: Biker, Yasmín og Pablo.
investigation: Current 2020 thumbnail references exist and returned HTTP 200 with byte-identical image files; the moved photo old URLs returned HTTP 404 before restoration. No evidence of a general server outage was established.
